response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS st, AVG(g.pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals g JOIN telescopes t ON g.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.equipstatus HAVING AVG(g.pulsepersec) IS NOT NULL), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.st, s.a, s.a - m1.m AS ex1 FROM s, m1 WHERE s.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k), r AS (SELECT k.a, k.ex1, k.a - m2.m AS ex2 FROM k, m2 WHERE k.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(ex1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(ex2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM r

assumptions.assumption: Statuses whose signals all have NULL pulse rates have no average and are excluded from the first mean. A NULL equipstatus on a telescope would form its own group, which is kept.
The result is one row of three values. If no status passes the second filter, all three values are NULL.
